title: Discount code can be applied more than once in cart
body: Clicking Apply repeatedly stacks the SAVE10 discount on the cart total.

title: Tax rounding is off by a cent
body: Cart tax is truncated instead of rounded.

title: Search results show stale results when typing fast
body: Older search responses overwrite newer ones.

title: Login button misaligned on mobile
body: Cosmetic: the login button overlaps the logo on small screens.
